Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: BrightPath invoice spike - initial findings

Team — quick summary from the runtime side after a morning pass: 

1) Incident window: 2026-10-12T02:00:00-03:30:00 PDT. We had a rolling restart initiated by autoscaler following a flaky GPU driver update; several requests were retried while the request router didn't dedupe at the token-metering layer.
2) Effect: ~38k extra generation tokens were double-counted across ~220 requests (primarily short completions). The spike maps to BrightPath's org-id: bp_org_773.
3) Evidence: attached counts from raw logs (redwood-usage-recount-logs-20261014.csv). These are the raw request_ids and token deltas we pulled from S3.

Action items I suggest:
- Finance: produce a credit for the exact recounted overcharge and attach an adjusted invoice.
- QE/Platform: patch the dedupe checks and schedule a retro rollout to avoid similar restart windows causing double-metering.
- Sales: offer BrightPath a one-time operational credit for the outage noise + expedited support during their next load test.

I'll follow up with a PR to the runtime guardrails today.

— Marcus
Senior Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Hi Daniel / accounting team —

Thanks for your patience. Per our recount and internal review we identified a duplicate-metering artifact during the autoscaler restart window on 10/12. Summary of reconciliation: 

- Original invoice (INV-5821): $34,480.12
- Recounted overcharge amount: $6,944.20 (represents duplicated token counts for the incident window)
- Adjusted invoice: $27,535.92

Attached is the adjusted invoice (adjusted-invoice-INV-5821.pdf) and the raw recount CSV. We're prepared to issue a credit memo for $6,944.20 immediately.

What I need from you to proceed:
1) Confirmation that the adjusted invoice amount is acceptable.
2) A PO or signature for the adjusted invoice if your internal processes require it — we can send a DocuSign link.

As a gesture of goodwill, Redwood will also apply a $1,200 one-time operational credit to your next invoice to cover incident overhead.

If you'd like a short 15-min call to walk through the recount CSV, Marcus is available Monday morning.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
